messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the relnotes for v0.11.0 (targeting next Tues). Need a short bullets list of user-facing changes + any known issues. I pushed a rough draft in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789.
sara: On it. I'll add the SDK snippet changes and callouts for the new streaming param. Want me to also include the migration note for users on older client libs?
jamie: yes please include migration notes — broke a couple internal flows when we changed the `streaming=true` default. Short example is fine.
morgan: I can run a quick link-check pass tomorrow morning and fix any 404s. Noticed one embed sample in the draft that still points to the old gist.
alex: Thanks. For SDK snippets, keep examples <= 6 lines and show both py/js where possible. Example form:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
client.generate("Summarize this...", streaming=True)
```
jamie: adding a JS snippet too. Also flagging known issue: embeddings endpoint sometimes 429s under high-concurrency with Dedicated burst enabled — adding under Known Issues with repro steps.
sara: repro steps? I can put a mini-qa snippet. Something like: run `wrk` with 200 concurrent connections to /v1/embeddings and watch for 429s after 30s.
morgan: link-check pass found 1 broken link: docs/guides/old-embed.md -> should point to docs/guides/embeddings-migration.md. I'll push a tiny fix in the PR.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs CI will run on your push. Expect link-check + snippet linter to report within ~5m.
alex: If CI lints pass, I'll merge tomorrow AM and create relnotes broadcast. Please add a one-line TL;DR for the announcement (1 sentence maximum).
sara: TL;DR candidate: "v0.11.0 — faster streaming, improved batching heuristics, and minor SDK changes (see migration notes)."
jamie: LGTM. I'm adding the canary rollout note for Dedicated customers and the fallback guidance for private deploys.
morgan: One more ask — can we add a short example showing how to enable prefix caching? Folks keep asking. I'll draft a tiny snippet and drop it in the examples folder.
alex: Perfect. Assign reviewers: @sara @jamie. If no objections by 10:00 PT tomorrow I'll ship. :thumbsup:
